steps.label: count_by_sev
steps.ppl: source=mock-mixed-pi | where @timestamp >= '2026-04-10 00:00:00' and @timestamp < '2026-04-11 00:00:00' | stats count() by severityText

steps.label: filter_error
steps.ppl: source=mock-mixed-pi | where @timestamp >= '2026-04-10 00:00:00' and @timestamp < '2026-04-11 00:00:00' | where severityText='ERROR' | stats count()

steps.label: error_by_service
steps.ppl: source=mock-mixed-pi | where @timestamp >= '2026-04-10 00:00:00' and @timestamp < '2026-04-11 00:00:00' | where severityText='ERROR' | stats count() by resource.attributes.service.name

steps.label: error_timeline
steps.ppl: source=mock-mixed-pi | where @timestamp >= '2026-04-10 00:00:00' and @timestamp < '2026-04-11 00:00:00' | where severityText='ERROR' | stats count() by span(@timestamp, 1h)

steps.label: error_sample
steps.ppl: source=mock-mixed-pi | where @timestamp >= '2026-04-10 00:00:00' and @timestamp < '2026-04-11 00:00:00' | where severityText='ERROR' | head 100

steps.label: rex_extract
steps.ppl: source=mock-mixed-pi | where @timestamp >= '2026-04-10 00:00:00' and @timestamp < '2026-04-11 00:00:00' | where severityText='ERROR' | rex field=body '(?<w>\w+)' | head 100

steps.label: rex_aggregate
steps.ppl: source=mock-mixed-pi | where @timestamp >= '2026-04-10 00:00:00' and @timestamp < '2026-04-11 00:00:00' | where severityText='ERROR' | rex field=body '(?<w>\w+)' | stats count() by w

steps.label: dedup_pod
steps.ppl: source=mock-mixed-pi | where @timestamp >= '2026-04-10 00:00:00' and @timestamp < '2026-04-11 00:00:00' | where severityText='ERROR' | dedup resource.attributes.k8s.pod.name | head 100

steps.label: sort_recent
steps.ppl: source=mock-mixed-pi | where @timestamp >= '2026-04-10 00:00:00' and @timestamp < '2026-04-11 00:00:00' | where severityText='ERROR' | sort @timestamp | head 50
